steps.message:
Build and unit tests pass.

## Diagnosis

The "Copy URL" (and "Share via") action on a **video** produced a **channel** URL.

Cause: video menus (`menu_youtube_player.xml`, `video_options_menu.xml`) contain top-level `@+id/share` / `@+id/copyurl` items for the *video*, plus a nested "channel related" submenu. But every video menu handler ran `actionHandler.handleChannelActions(...)` **first**:

```java
if (actionHandler.handleChannelActions(context, youTubeVideo.getChannel(), item.getItemId())) {
    return true;   // swallowed R.id.copyurl / R.id.share
}
switch (item.getItemId()) {
    case R.id.copyurl: youTubeVideo.copyUrl(context); // never reached
```

Since `ChannelActionHandler` handled `R.id.copyurl`/`R.id.share` with `channel.getChannelUrl()` and returned `true`, the video branches were dead code — the channel URL was copied instead of `https://youtu.be/<videoId>`.

The doubled prefix in the report (`https://www.youtube.com/https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC…`) came from a second defect: `YouTubeChannel.getChannelUrl()` fed the raw `id` field into `YoutubeChannelLinkHandlerFactory.getUrl()`; for legacy records where the id is stored as a full channel URL, the factory prepends the base URL again.

## Fix

1. **`ChannelActionHandler.java`** — the URL actions are now only handled when the caller explicitly asks for it (channel-only menus), via a new `handleUrlActions` parameter; the existing 3-arg overload keeps the old behaviour (`true`). Also added a null-channel guard to avoid NPEs when the player menu is used before the channel is loaded.
2. **`GridViewHolder.java`, `YouTubePlayerV1Fragment.java`, `YouTubePlayerV2Fragment.java`** — video menus now pass `false`, so `R.id.copyurl`/`R.id.share` fall through to `youTubeVideo.copyUrl(...)` / `shareVideo(...)`, which use `getVideoUrl()` → `https://youtu.be/<id>`. Channel actions (subscribe, block, open channel…) in those menus still work.
3. **`YouTubeChannel.getChannelUrl()`** — uses `getChannelId().getRawId()` (prefix-stripped) so the channel menu can no longer emit a duplicated `https://www.youtube.com/https://www.youtube.com/channel/...` URL.
